description: Open-sea passage; a jammer degrades reception until the fix is lost, then clears.
trainer_note: Watch the GSV SNR fall together and satellites vanish from the lowest elevation up before GGA quality drops to 0 and RMC goes to V. Heading (HDT) and water speed (VBW) stay healthy throughout: the fall-back is dead reckoning on those. After the jammer clears the fix returns only after the receiver has re-acquired.

events.description: Jammer ahead: jamming: received C/N0 falls by up to 34 dB (per-satellite spread 6 dB); satellites drop out and the fix is lost when fewer than four remain usable from T+300 s for 420 s (onset ramp 90 s, recovery ramp 60 s)

timeline.text: the receiver has no fix (3 usable satellites, four needed)
the receiver reports a fix again (11 satellites used)
